title: A Universal Non-Concentration Principle: SND ≡ GNC ≡ Bridge
desc:
We prove that three a priori distinct non-concentration conditions on the prime lattice Hamiltonian Q_N(i,j) = 1/gcd(i,j) are equivalent:

(i) SND (Spectral Non-Dispersal): no single dyadic shell of the Navier–Stokes solution captures more than fraction ρ₀ of total energy.

(ii) GNC (Goldbach Non-Concentration): the prime indicator difference vector v_k satisfies ⟨v_k, Ĥ_N v_k⟩ ≥ κ*‖v_k‖² (no dark state).
